description: Baseline labeling benchmark on a tiny monitor fixture. Two refs, five quotes, exercises feature/use-case evidence, issues (label+sentiment), and the speculative flag. Compares current production system prompt against an alternate iteration file.

expectations.desiredOutcome: Every input productId returns at least one quote with feature/useCase/issues evidence. The G-Sync quote on c1 gets a 'pc gaming' useCase. The black-screen quote on c2 gets an issues[] entry with label='vrr black screen' and sentiment='strongNegative'. The coating quote on c2 gets a coating feature with negative sentiment. No speculative flags (everything is first-hand).

judge.instructions: Score each candidate 1-10 on (1) faithfulness — labels match the quote's actual content using only labels from the vocabulary; no hallucinated labels; speculative flag set correctly; (2) calibration — issue label comes from the closed list and severity (negative vs strongNegative) reflects the speaker's wording; feature/useCase sentiments match the speaker's evaluation; (3) completeness — every input productId is returned with at least one quote labeled when quotes describe a feature, use case, or symptom. Hard penalties: hallucinated label not in the vocabulary → faithfulness ≤4; missing the 'vrr black screen' issue → faithfulness ≤6; tagging a generic verdict ('I love it') with a feature → calibration ≤5. Return JSON {candidates:[{candidateId, scores:{faithfulness, calibration, completeness}, rationale}], verdict}.
